name: SGNP Cafeteria
why_it_matters: Sanjay Gandhi National Park gate-side cafeteria 200m inside the Borivali East entry — the only food option within the park before the Kanheri shuttle to the 109-cave Buddhist site. Basic Maharashtrian thali + vada pav + samosa + filter coffee for Kanheri-Tulsi-Yeoor visitors.
insider_tip: Take the Kanheri shuttle bus from the gate (₹25/head) — first bus 7.45am, last 4.30pm. Eat post-Kanheri 12-2pm before the 2pm shuttle wave fills the cafeteria. Cash + UPI; no cards.
signature_address: SGNP Borivali East Gate, Borivali East, Mumbai 400066

name: Hotel Anand Bhuvan (Borivali East base)
why_it_matters: Long-running multi-cuisine pure-veg institution near Borivali East station, 5km from the SGNP-Kanheri gate — Maharashtrian unlimited thali + South-Indian breakfast tiffin for the Mumbai-suburban commuter base and Kanheri-visit pre-trip eat.
insider_tip: Pre-Kanheri breakfast 6-9am quietest (commuter wave 7.30-10am peak). SGNP gate opens 7.30am — eat at Anand Bhuvan 6.30, then auto to SGNP by 7am. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Near Borivali East Station, Borivali East, Mumbai 400066

name: Sukhsagar Borivali (Borivali West base)
why_it_matters: Borivali West Chandavarkar Road institution — Bombay-Maharashtrian unlimited thali + Mumbai street-food classics (pav bhaji, misal, vada pav) in a sit-down setting. 7km from SGNP-Kanheri gate. The Borivali-side post-Kanheri lunch default.
insider_tip: Pav bhaji is the going order (Mumbai-classic; butter-loaded). Sunday lunch + Saturday dinner peak with Mumbai-suburban families. Cards + UPI.
